edges.condition: Main-loop code label inside application function.
Object first word receives this vtable address during construction.
First entry 0x08010255 is a Thumb function pointer, not an instruction address.
Self subscriber reached through the first virtual method; other subscribers are not exhaustively mapped.
This instance is note object +4; other instances of the same helper exist.
Startup current pointer; later modes may select another block.
Slot 0 is one possible selected block, not a permanent binding.
Actual BL site after effective-step calculation.
Retention reads the current block even if old Note On used a different block.
Writes through current block in place; not an implicit staging buffer.
Native Time Div reads can be separated by IRQ execution.
Guarded external transport action reaches the native router.
Writer and DMA submission use the same live waveform buffer; this is not a call edge.
